policy: Promote feedback only when the dependent readout changes the channel that generated it; keep shared ambient and wall factors out of motif fits.

promote_now: EM/BE dress -> contact length -> mass-density packing
spectral scale anchor -> em -> contact length -> BE / density / transport
phase density -> B_hom -> polarizability/material response -> phase density
strain / piezo -> contact length -> stiffness -> strain
conductivity -> Joule/thermal release -> thermo voltage -> conductivity
thermal conductivity -> temperature profile -> B_hom / release contrast -> thermal conductivity

summary.top_priority: EM/BE dress -> contact length -> mass-density packing

rows.loop: EM/BE dress -> contact length -> mass-density packing
rows.reason: Mass is an in-situ scale anchor, not a freeze. The EM/BE channel feeds back into r via r_eff = r_bare · em^α · (1 + base·open²), and density follows the packing power law.
rows.next_action: Generic covalent_network_em_packing_dress is live for length-reliable networks; period≥3 Si/Ge stay bare until upstream shell geometry promotes.

rows.loop: spectral scale anchor -> em -> contact length -> BE / density / transport
rows.reason: A spectral pin should set an in-situ scale, then score other outputs. It should not be evaluated by re-scoring the pinned omega.

residual_audit.diagnosis: Most B_e residual is length-propagated through B_e ~ 1/r_e^2; after shell length/energy dresses the reliable panel is near-closed, so remaining work is finer contact geometry and non-spectral feedback.

rows.next_action: Spectral panel is near-closed; keep shell length closed unless a new reliable row exceeds the near-closed band, and score packing through the live EM/open-channel dress.

rows.loop: phase density -> B_hom -> polarizability/material response -> phase density
rows.reason: Material response already uses rho_curv to compute polarizability, thermal conductivity, heat capacity, and viscosity. Some of those responses change the effective phase density or contact scale, so one pass is structurally incomplete.
rows.next_action: Fixed-point iterator now converges with full updates; use the converged rho_curv as the material-table state, and keep one-way tables only for comparison.

rows.loop: strain / piezo -> contact length -> stiffness -> strain
rows.reason: The carbon residual-as-piezo probe was diagnostic only. For real walls, strain should be a mechanical equilibrium variable: strain moves r, r changes stiffness, stiffness changes strain response.
rows.next_action: Add a small fixed-point strain closure driven by wall spectrum or external stress; do not infer strain from the scored bond-length error.

rows.loop: conductivity -> Joule/thermal release -> thermo voltage -> conductivity
rows.reason: Neutral pure media correctly keep carrier_fraction=0. In electrolytes or doped sheets, conductivity changes local heating/release contrast, which feeds back through the thermo channel.
rows.next_action: Only enable for explicit carriers/salinity/doping; leave pure neutral rows at identity.

rows.loop: thermal conductivity -> temperature profile -> B_hom / release contrast -> thermal conductivity
rows.reason: k_th currently reads rho_curv and B_hom one-way. Under a gradient, temperature profile and release contrast are dynamic state variables.
rows.next_action: Keep isothermal material tables one-way; add a gradient assay mode with finite update steps.

rows.loop: wall spectrum -> localDefect / tribo -> contact length -> wall spectrum
rows.reason: Wall/interface should generally be a shared spectrum, not a separate per-molecule fit. Only if adsorption deforms the wall should this become two-way.
rows.next_action: Treat wall as shared factor by default; add two-way adsorption only for explicit surface reconstruction / defect growth assays.

rows.reason: The literal eV/c^2 mass defect is real but far too small to explain chemistry-scale density residuals. The important mass feedback is through EM-dressed contact length, not direct mass subtraction.
rows.next_action: Record as precision bookkeeping for isotope/mass-ledger work, not as a primary materials feedback.
